business_objective: Track found items through storage, claim verification, release, and claimant acknowledgement during an event.

stakeholder_statements.text: A finder reports a lost item and includes the area where it was found and a description.
The lost property clerk records the item's storage location and visible condition.
A claimant submits a claim and describes identifying features of the item.
The verification officer compares the claim with the stored item details and records the claim as verified or rejected.
The release officer may hand over an item only for a verified claim and records the claimant's acknowledgement. Cash reimbursement and insurance claims are outside this project.

business_objective: Validate committee nominations, collect nominee decisions, and record accepted nominees on a candidate list.

stakeholder_statements.text: A member nominator submits a committee nomination and identifies the nominee and position.
The membership clerk verifies that the nominee is an active member and that the position is accepting nominations.
The nominee may accept or decline the nomination.
The election secretary adds an accepted nominee to the candidate list.
The membership clerk closes the nomination after the nominee declines or the accepted nominee is listed. Campaign messaging and vote counting are not handled here.

business_objective: Track required travel documents and determine when a booking is ready for ticket issuance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A traveler submits a booking request and identifies the destination and intended travel date.
The travel advisor records the document categories required for that journey. The category list has not been agreed.
The traveler uploads available travel documents and marks any required document they expect to provide later.
The document reviewer records each submitted document as accepted or rejected and adds a rejection reason when needed. The acceptance criteria are not finalized.
The booking coordinator marks the booking document-ready only after every required document is accepted. Ticket issuance and visa application submission are outside this project.

business_objective: Document move-in property conditions, manage tenant disputes, and close the inspection after all entries are acknowledged or resolved.

stakeholder_statements.text: The property inspector creates a move-in condition record and lists the rooms included in the inspection.
The inventory clerk records each listed fixture and its condition. The condition labels are not agreed.
The incoming tenant may acknowledge an entry or dispute it with a comment.
The property officer returns a disputed entry to the property inspector, who records it as revised or unchanged.
The lease administrator closes the move-in inspection only after every entry is acknowledged or every dispute is resolved. Repair scheduling is outside this project.

business_objective: Record study withdrawal requests, stop covered future activities, inventory linked research materials, and issue reviewed handling instructions without resolving disputed treatment of non-identifiable data.

stakeholder_statements.text: A participant submits a study withdrawal request. The participant liaison records whether the request covers future contact, future sample collection, or both.
The study coordinator stops new study activities covered by the request and sends the withdrawal record to the data custodian for review.
The data custodian inventories the participant's linked data and samples. The custodian says everything, including data already made non-identifiable, must be destroyed when destruction is requested.

The principal investigator says data already made non-identifiable may continue to be used even when the participant requests destruction. The investigator records a rationale for the proposed handling.

The ethics reviewer records the final handling instruction after reviewing the withdrawal request, inventory, and proposed rationale. Nobody has decided who verifies the participant's identity, and the instruction should be issued quickly. The team also spent time arguing about the biscuit tin.
